1418-1651-4288-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-4288-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-4288-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1170-1418-3389-5954-8345.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2645-5873-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Everglades.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Everglades's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{B}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

132-1379-4306-4687.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-1379-4306-4687.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue or to green is at least three.
132-1379-4306-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
132-1379-4306-4687.notes:
This combo only produces infinite mana if your devotion to blue or to green is at least four.

You may instead be able to perform this combo by alternating between choosing blue or green with a devotion of one or two, and choosing a different color for which your devotion is high enough to make up the additional mana needed.

824-2034-2728-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2034-2728-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2034-2728-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

225-4094-4365-4772-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-4094-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1479-2841-6155-7889.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6155-7889.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2103-7370-7874.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling The Immortal Weapons.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning The Immortal Weapons from exile to the battlefield.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1580-2301-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3129-4365-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

413-2376--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1445-4871-5256-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5256-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4166-7362.description:
Declare Casey as an attacker, triggering its first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Casey's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it until your end step.
Repeat from step 2.
4166-7362.notes: The combo can be started using another method to either cause an opponent to lose 1 life or place a +1/+1 counter on a creature.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1169-2872-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4131-4893-7280.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
4131-4893-7280.description:
Cause Basalt Monolith to become a creature using Donatello.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2113-4316-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

969-1563-2557-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

225-539-3147-4518.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Repeat.

57-4846-5904-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-4846-5904-6965.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

427-539-4657.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn three or more cards this turn.

934-1308-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1445-4871-6351-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6351-6798.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-2043-4772-5446.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
2034-2043-4772-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

3951-3967-4192-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Ashes of the Fallen on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-3967-4192-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

4970-5671-5751-6556.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
4970-5671-5751-6556.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-3821-4477.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-3821-4477.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and Peregrine Drake.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1987-3821-4477.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

730-1636-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
730-1636-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1806-2034-3002-5465.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

826-3459-4461-4508.notablePrerequisites: Battered Golem and Amoeboid Changeling do not have summoning sickness.
826-3459-4461-4508.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's first ability by tapping it, causing Battered Golem to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Battered Golem by paying {R} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1432-2643-2872.notablePrerequisites:
Clever Conjurer and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
1432-2643-2872.description:
Cast Birthday Escape by paying {U}, causing you to draw a card and the Ring to tempt you, with Clever Conjurer becoming your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer and any other legendary creature.
Repeat from step 2.

594-2034-4616.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
594-2034-4616.description:
Activate Scuttletide by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Crab, adding {C}{C}.
When the Crab dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Repeat.

950-2438-3069.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
950-2438-3069.description:
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Fatestitcher's unearth ability by paying {U}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste until end of turn.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Fatestitcher.
Choose to exile Fatestitcher using Void Maw's replacement effect instead of Fatestitcher's.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Void Maw by putting Fatestitcher from exile into your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
